prompt: spyWarning loses falsy arguments: after const spy = spyWarning(w), calling w('a', 0) records spy.calls[0].arguments as ['a'] instead of ['a', 0], and w(0) records []. Make the spy record every argument the warning was actually called with.
requirement: spyWarning records, for each call, the arguments the warning was called with: only trailing undefined values are dropped (warning() always receives three parameters). Any other value, including 0, '', false and null, is kept in position; an undefined value before a supplied one is kept as undefined.
adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit; behaviour outside the requirement is not graded.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev split only)
provenance.notes: Real behaviour of process-warning v5.1.0 (spy checks arguments by truthiness).
